title: Getting settled
summary: Start with residency, a temporary stay, and your documents. ADRO relocation services cover home search, school search, orientation, and settling-in support. For a bank account, gather your identity and residency documents and compare the account's salary, balance, and fee requirements.

title: Finding a home
summary: Compare neighbourhoods around your daily commute. Yas Island and Saadiyat Island offer island communities; Khalifa City and Shakhbout City are family-oriented options. Shortlist homes, view them, then agree on rent and payment dates. Landlords register leases in Tawtheeq. For utilities, tenants need identity documents and the tenancy contract.

title: Residency and entry
summary: Choose the application category first. ICP processes entry permits through its website and app: submit the application, review the details, attach the category's documents, and pay the displayed fee. Entry arrangements and residency are separate steps. Your category determines the document list and conditions; a nationality alone does not establish eligibility.

title: Moving with family
summary: A family member's residence permit is linked to their sponsor's residence permit. Prepare passport copies and proof of relationship, such as marriage and birth certificates. Medical fitness tests apply to adult dependants aged 18 or above. Family sponsorship has income and relationship conditions, so select the applicable category before submitting.

title: Starting your company
summary: Choose your business activity and legal form, reserve a trade name, and obtain initial approval. Prepare incorporation agreements and premises when required, complete activity-specific approvals, then apply for the economic licence. ADDED provides licensing services through TAMM. Company formation and personal residency are separate parts of the move.

title: Self-sponsored routes
summary: Green residence categories include skilled workers, freelancers and self-employed people, and investors or business partners. The Green visa is a renewable five-year route without an employer sponsor and can include family sponsorship. Each category has its own qualification, income, permit, or investment requirements. Start by selecting the category that matches your work.

title: School and healthcare
summary: Abu Dhabi offers British, American, IB, French, and other curricula. Shortlist schools by curriculum, commute, and fees, then ask about places and admission dates. Health insurance is part of residency preparation: arrange cover for each person and keep the policy ready for the application.

title: Getting around
summary: Use DARBI to plan bus journeys and a Hafilat card for bus travel. Taxis are available on the street and through the Abu Dhabi Taxi app; Uber and Careem also operate. Test your commute before choosing a home. For driving, start with the licence exchange or traffic-file route that applies to your current licence.

title: Everyday essentials
summary: Register your tenancy through Tawtheeq before setting up household water and electricity. Keep your passport, Emirates ID, and tenancy contract together. Arrange mobile service for arrival, then choose a home internet plan based on coverage at your address.
